F-01.reason: ING-05-FR-1 / FR-2 / FR-3 / FR-4 / D-01 / D-03 / ADR-0015. Deltas from the shipped draft: (a) declare a module-level `const JOURNAL_CODEC_VERSION = "1";` immediately below the file header, and update the header comment to pin `JOURNAL_CODEC_VERSION` verbatim + document the observed Copilot Chat journal schema shape 'as of 2026-09-15' (kind 0 snapshot, kind 1 set, kind 2 push; nested `requests[]`; `modelId`, `promptTokens`, `completionTokens`, `copilotCredits'); (b) inside the kind-dispatch loop (currently at lines ~163-176), keep the `{0,1,2}` branches unchanged and add an explicit else-branch that skips the record and writes exactly one `{event:'journal_codec_unknown_kind', kind:<value>, codec_version:'1', ts:<iso>}` line to `docs/activity/.mcp-push.log` per session-end (via a `logOnce(event, extra)` helper that dedupes by `event+kind` within this process). Never abort the batch; row emission for surrounding valid kinds proceeds. (c) Add a `resolveProgramId(projectDir)` helper that returns `process.env.HARNESS_PROGRAM_ID.trim()` when non-empty, else parses `<projectDir>/.harness/program.yaml` and reads `program_id` (fallback legacy key `programId`), else returns `null`. Import a minimal YAML parser: use `readFileSync + a hand-rolled top-level key-value scan` matching what `services/mcp-server/src/agentrise_mcp/core/profile.py` reads (top-level scalar `key: value`), so no new npm dependency is introduced. When `resolveProgramId` returns `null`: write `{event:'program_id_unresolved', ts:<iso>}` to `.mcp-push.log`, SKIP the NDJSON append entirely for this session-end, and exit 0 without spawning the push child. (d) Set `record.program_id = <resolved>` on the row object literal at § 13 immediately after `record.source = 'copilot'` and BEFORE the NDJSON write. (e) Replace the feature regex at § 6 `String(commandEvent?.data?.content || '').match(/([A-Z]{2,}-\d+)/)` with the exact bare-token positional regex `^/\S+\s+([A-Z]{2,4}-\d+)\b` per FR-4; anything else (including `--feature <id>`) yields `feature = null`. (f) Leave `cache_read: 0` and `cache_write: 0` as literal 0 (FR-3, already correct in the shipped draft) — do NOT change to null. (g) Route the existing MCP-push spawn's log writes through the same `logOnce` / structured writer used by (b) and (c) so `.mcp-push.log` line shape is uniform JSON — replace the two current freeform `${stamp} SPAWN ${mcpPush}\n` / `${stamp} NO_SCRIPT_FOUND ...` appendFileSync calls with `{event:'spawn'|'no_script_found', ts:..., ...}` JSON lines matching the DATA-DESIGN.md § 1 log-line allowlist (NEVER include `program_id`, `user`, journal contents). No new imports beyond what the existing `import ... from 'node:fs'` block covers.

F-02.reason: ING-05-FR-5 / D-02 / NFR-performance / NFR-security / NFR-observability. Deltas from the shipped draft: (a) change `const TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;` at line 22 to `const TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;` (D-02). (b) update the header comment to note the `TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000` decision (single attempt, no retry, fire-and-forget contract per AC-2) and reference PRD ING-05-FR-5. (c) enforce IPv4 loopback: after resolving `MCP_URL`, parse its host via `new URL(MCP_URL).hostname`; if the host is not `127.0.0.1` and not `::1`, write `{event:'mcp_url_non_loopback', ts:<iso>, mcp_url_host:<host>}` and `process.exit(0)` BEFORE any fetch attempt (NFR-Security). (d) add a `writeLog(event, extra)` helper that (i) JSON-stringifies `{event, ts:new Date().toISOString(), ...extra}` filtered to the allowlist `{event, ts, http_status, error_code, duration_ms, mcp_url_host}` — any other key is silently dropped (allowlist diff, not denylist), (ii) reads `.mcp-push.log` size + line count and truncate-and-rewrites when either hard cap (100 lines / 32 KB) would be exceeded, keeping the tail (D-04 from ING-05-NFR-observability). Bytes measured via `Buffer.byteLength(joined,'utf8')`. (e) replace the two current freeform `console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:...}))` calls at the end of `main()` and in the `.catch` with `writeLog('success', {duration_ms})` / `writeLog('http_error'|'network_error'|'timeout', {http_status?, error_code?, duration_ms})` and always `process.exit(0)` — the `process.exit(1)` in the current catch is a contract violation of AC-5 (parent hook must never see non-zero exit) and MUST be removed. (f) classify failure modes inside the catch: `AbortError` → `timeout`; `TypeError` or `ECONNREFUSED`/`ENOTFOUND` error → `network_error`; a rejected `!res.ok` throw carrying an HTTP status → `http_error`. (g) capture `duration_ms` via `performance.now()` bookends around each RPC call and record the LAST failing call's duration. (h) NEVER include `program_id`, `user`, `command`, `Authorization`, bearer token substring, or backend response body in any log line (NFR-Security field allowlist). Structural: no new imports beyond `node:perf_hooks` (for `performance.now()`) and `node:fs` (already imported effectively via the fetch/AbortController path — add the `readFileSync`/`writeFileSync`/`appendFileSync`/`statSync` imports needed for the rotator).

(d) `test('program_id unresolved skips write')` — delete env var, remove program.yaml, assert activity.jsonl gains zero rows and .mcp-push.log gains exactly one JSON line with `event==='program_id_unresolved'` (TC-01 case C, closes the ING-04 141× regression class). (g) `test('feature parsed as bare-token positional only', parametrised)` — table `[['/plan BED-01', 'BED-01'], ['/plan --feature BED-01', null], ['/plan', null], ['/plan BED-01 extra', 'BED-01'], ['/plan feature=BED-01', null], ['/plan -f BED-01', null]]`, assert emitted `row.feature` matches expected for each (FR-4). (h) `test('detached spawn is fire-and-forget')` — stub the spawn boundary (`await import('node:child_process')` monkey-patch, or use `--experimental-vm-modules` mock), invoke the parent entrypoint end-to-end, assert `spawn` was called with `options.detached === true`, `options.stdio` ignoring stdin, `child.unref()` was invoked, and the parent's returned promise settled without awaiting the (fake) child (TC-02 non-blocking spawn assertion). Tests write to a `tmp_path` per test via `mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir()+'/ing-05-')`, set `projectDir` via `process.env.workspaceFolder`, and restore env/FS state in `after` hooks.
